title: Daily digest: Navratri Fever Grips Celebs Too | BRS MLC seeks Rs 20k-cr package to deal  | John Brittas seeks President’s intervent | Indian-origin siblings sold cookies in 2
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Deccan Chronicle / Munsif Daily / The Hindu / Times of India
bullets_en: BRS MLC seeks Rs 20k-cr package to deal with Telangana drought.
John Brittas seeks President’s intervention as JNU students’ hunger strike enters 17th day.
Indian-origin siblings sold cookies in 2018; charity gave 100,000 books.
bullets_ur: Navratri ka khumar celebrities par bhi chha gaya
BRS MLC ne Telangana ke khushk saali se nimatne ke liye 20 hazar crore rupay ke package ka mutalba kiya
John Brittas ne President ki mudaakhilat talab ki, JNU talba ki bhook hartal 17ween din mein daakhil
Bharati asl ke bhai-behen ne 2018 mein cookies bechi; khairati idare ne 100,000 kitaben diye.
